description: This file defines an interface `ResourceOwnerAccessTokenInterface` that extends `AccessTokenInterface`. It specifies a method `getResourceOwnerId()` intended to return the resource owner identifier associated with an access token in OAuth 2.0.

classes.name: ResourceOwnerAccessTokenInterface
classes.description: An interface representing an access token with an associated resource owner ID, extending the standard AccessTokenInterface for OAuth 2.0 tokens.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the resource owner identifier, if defined, associated with the access token.
